articles.title: U.S. government digital dollar set to be banned tonight under housing law's CBDC limit
articles.snippet: Despite President Donald Trump's refusal to sign Congress' bipartisan housing bill, it's set to go into effect at midnight, and its temporary CBDC ban along with it.

articles.title: White House says it received no Democratic response related to SEC, CFTC vacancies
articles.snippet: Both US financial regulators are understaffed at the leadership level and lacking Democratic commissioners, with no announcement from President Donald Trump on filling the roles.

articles.title: Bitcoin traders reveal key levels as BTC price passes $63K after Trump Iran 'deal' comments
articles.snippet: Bitcoin gained new upside targets for the daily close and beyond after US president Donald Trump said that Iran "wants to make a deal."

articles.title: Trump Won't Sign Housing Bill With CBDC Ban—Will It Become Law Tonight Anyway?
articles.snippet: Unless President Trump vetoes the bill, it will become law at midnight, banning the Federal Reserve from developing a CBDC until 2031.

articles.title: EU Set to Revise MiCA in 2027 to Cover Foreign Stablecoin Issuers
articles.snippet: Trump's embrace of stablecoins is pushing Brussels to expand its crypto law to non-EU issuers and tokenized payments, EU diplomats say.
